item.title: Anthropic says it will sue Pentagon over supply chain risk label
item.description: The clash centers on two red lines Anthropic refused to drop during negotiations with the Department of Defense: using Claude for mass domestic surveillance of Americans and for fully autonomous weapons. item.title: Epic beat Google in court, but Tim Sweeney can't criticize Play Store policies until 2032
item.description: The revelation came this week, when the binding term sheet for Epic's settlement with Google showed that Epic CEO Tim Sweeney, once the industry's most vivid critic of platform monopolies, is bound by a non-disparagement clause that bars him from publicly criticizing Google on matters related to Play Store distribution...Read Entire Article

item.title: GTA Online players in Australia will soon face age checks under new R18+ gaming rules
item.description: The requirement states that search engines, social media platforms, pornographic websites, app stores, gaming providers, and generative AI systems – including explicit chatbots – must take "meaningful steps" to prevent children from being exposed to age-inappropriate content.Read Entire Article

item.title: TCL unveils 4K 240Hz OLED dual-mode monitor that's just 6.4mm thick
item.description: The recently unveiled 32X3A is a 31.5-inch display that can switch between 4K at 240Hz and 480Hz at a lower resolution, likely 1080p, with a grayscale response time of 0.03 milliseconds. item.title: London doctor carries out remote robot surgery on cancer patient 1,500 miles away
item.description: The milestone procedure saw Professor Prokar Dasgupta, based at The London Clinic's robotic center in Harley Street, operate on 62-year-old patient Paul Buxton, who was in St Bernard's Hospital in Gibraltar, a British overseas territory in southern Spain.Read Entire Article
